column1: # *** ONE HOUSEHOLD READ TWICE, UNDER TWO SURNAMES - AND THE DUPLICATES GATE FOUND IT. ***
# 11 October 2026. Work-list row 186 asked who the "Zalduando" was that Angelica Maria Lerena
# Villademoros married. The answer is the hardest kind: *** HE WAS ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER. ***
# Four civil-index entries were worked up as a NEW family - an "Eduardo ZALDUANDO POU", his parents
# JUAN and DOLORES POU, his Lerena wife, and a daughter MARIA MARGARITA. Every one of them had been
# entered on 21 September 2026 off a PLATE, under *** ZALSAMENDI ***, from the baptism of
# Maria Margarita at San Juan Bautista, Pocitos, on 15 August 1903.
# *** THE AGREEMENT IS FIVEFOLD AND NONE OF IT DEPENDS ON THE DISPUTED SURNAME: ***
#   the husband is EDUARDO - his father is JUAN - his mother is DOLORES POU -
#   his wife is a LERENA daughter of AVELINO and CELEDONIA/CELIDONIA -
#   and there is a daughter called MARIA MARGARITA.
# Two unrelated Montevideo households do not agree on all five. *** IT IS ONE HOUSEHOLD. ***
# *** SO WHICH SURNAME IS RIGHT? THE PLATE'S. *** 1903 was read from the image; 1913 is an index,
# and it is the same index that writes Lerena as "Lerma" and Avelino Lerena as "Arabia Larena
# Lerena". And there is a tell: when this archive first met the 1903 act through a MACHINE
# TRANSCRIPT it read the father as *** "DEL SUANDO" *** - a string far closer to "Zalduando" than to
# what the plate turned out to say. The same hand defeats the same kind of reader twice.
# *** WHAT IS STILL NOT SETTLED, AND IT IS NOT A DETAIL: THE WIFE'S FORENAME. ***
# The 1903 plate says *** AMELIA *** Lerena. The 1913 index says *** ANGELICA *** Lerena, and the
# FamilySearch tree attaches it to Angelica Maria Lerena Villademoros, baptised 1872. Either they
# are ONE WOMAN under two readings of one cramped forename, or AMELIA IS A SISTER and the index has
# named the wrong one. *** THIS ARCHIVE WILL NOT CHOOSE ON A GUESS, AND THE TWO ARE NOT MERGED. ***
# *** THE TEST IS TWO PLATES, AND ONE OF THEM IS BLOCKED: ***
#   DGS 008165206 image 283 - the 1913 death act - was attempted on 11 October 2026 and the
#   FamilySearch image viewer *** REDIRECTED TO A SIGN-IN ***. That is false-zero disguise
#   seventeen, which this archive has been caught by before, so no conclusion is drawn from
#   the failure. Film 007713400 image 02828 folio 344 - the 1903 act - can be re-read for the
#   mother's forename whenever a session is signed in.

column4: *** THE STRONGEST LEG OF THE ARGUMENT. *** An index may mangle a Basque surname; it did not invent a Dolores Pou married to a Juan with a son Eduardo. And POU reappearing as the husband's own second surname is the ordinary Spanish form, which supports the match rather than weakening it.

column4: The PARENTS match exactly and the FORENAME does not. *** This is the one place the two records genuinely conflict ***, and it is left open.

column1: # *** AND A JOIN THAT NEEDED NO NEW DOCUMENT AT ALL. ***
# Amelia's row has asked since 14 September 2026 how her parents could be "AVELINO y CELIDONIA B. de
# LERENA" when Avelino Lerena Fernandez married Ambrosia Traibel. It set out the difficulty honestly
# and left it open: "Either he had a second wife, or Celidonia belongs to a DIFFERENT Avelino."
#   *** THE AVELINO IS NOT HIM. IT IS HIS SON - AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL - WHOSE WIFE IS
#   CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***, daughter of Pedro Villademoros and Angelica Mendez, already in this
# register with six children. "Celidonia B. de Lerena" is Celedonia in the married form.
# So the 1903 Pocitos household *** JOINS TO THE LERENA VILLADEMOROS, AND THROUGH THEM TO THE LERENA
# TRAIBEL *** - the join that row said this archive "has never" made. Both halves had been sitting
# here for three weeks. *** NOTHING WAS DISCOVERED TO CLOSE IT; TWO ROWS WERE SIMPLY READ TOGETHER. ***
# *** A CAUTION EARNED THE HARD WAY, recorded because it nearly reached the published site. ***
# The first draft of this work was written onto *** MARIA ANGELICA JULIA LERENA SALVANACH, born
# 1886 *** - the same four names as Angelica Maria Lerena Villademoros in a different order - by a
# prefix match on "Maria Angelica". It was caught by chronology before it was committed: the 1886
# woman would have been FIFTEEN when this couple's eldest son was born.
# *** NAME ORDER IS NOT IDENTITY, AND A PREFIX MATCH IS NOT A PERSON. ***
